visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young females sit at a glass-topped dining table in a bright indoor setting. The girl on the left has long black hair and a white sweatshirt; the girl on the right has long dark hair and a brown knit vest over a white shirt. A small chocolate cake with a single candle sits on a white plate between them. The background shows a balcony door and neutral-colored walls. (2) The scene cuts to a dimly lit indoor space, possibly a restaurant or social lounge. A group of young people is seen celebrating. A girl with braided hair and an off-the-shoulder grey knitted sweater claps her hands excitedly. A birthday cake with two lit candles is held by someone off-camera. The lighting is warm and low. (3) The camera returns to the first scene. The girl on the left closes her eyes and clasps her hands together in a prayer-like gesture, making a wish. She is shown in a medium close-up shot. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom. She smiles and leans forward as if to blow out the candle.
